name: 10301 · Staten Island, NY
findings: ZIP 10301 (Staten Island) has 167 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10301 (Staten Island) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10301 (Staten Island) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 55 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 10 arts and cultural organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do arts and cultural organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10301 (Staten Island) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

observations.text: 19 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
